data.name: Humaila
data.long_meaning: The name Humaila is derived from the Arabic language and holds a significant place in Islamic history. It is believed to be the name of the mother of a Prophet, making it a deeply spiritual and revered name for Muslim families. The meaning of the name can be traced back to the Arabic language, where it is composed of the words 'Hum' (mother) and 'Aila' (noble).
data.spiritual_meaning: A name cherished by Muslim families, symbolizing the love and devotion towards the Prophets and their mothers.
data.numerology_meaning: In Islamic numerology, Humaila's life path number 3 represents creativity, self-expression, and communication. This name is believed to inspire artistic and communicative abilities in those who bear it.
